description: Historical match price impact data for a fan token. Returns price snapshots at -24h, kickoff, fulltime, +1h, +24h with returns for each match. Filter by result (win/loss/draw), competition, venue. WINDOWS: return_total_pct is measured price_24h_before -> price_24h_after (it includes the pregame move, so it can differ in sign from a kickoff-anchored return); return_ko_to_24h_pct is kickoff -> +24h. See the 'semantics' block in the response. Use for backtesting sports-driven strategies.

result.description: Filter by match result. Default: all.

name: tokenintel_match_impact_history
